text:
You need a clean, user-friendly, and visually appealing maid housekeeping website built from scratch, and I’d be glad to help turn your ideas and branding into a polished launch-ready site.

I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack web developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications. My background includes JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API development, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, HTML, and CSS, which gives me the flexibility to handle both the design implementation and the underlying functionality your website needs.

For a project like this, I’d focus on creating a site that feels clean, trustworthy, and easy to navigate while still reflecting the quality and professionalism of your brand. Since you already have clear ideas and goals, I can work closely with your team to translate those concepts into a functional experience that matches your standards. I’m comfortable with regular communication and feedback loops, including Google Meet, Teams, or other tools, so we can stay aligned throughout the 2-month timeframe and keep the project moving smoothly.

One project I’d highlight is a live fleet dashboard for Ferrylane Freight in logistics. I built a dispatcher map showing every truck’s position and ETA, pushed to the browser as GPS pings arrived. The result was 1,800 trucks tracked live with under 2 seconds from ping to screen. That project required careful real-time thinking, strong attention to detail, and a user interface that made complex information easy to understand — all of which carry over well to a service website where clarity and responsiveness matter.

For your cleaning website, I’d bring the same practical approach: organized structure, clean visuals, strong mobile responsiveness, and a smooth user experience that supports your brand values. I’m detail-oriented, communicative, and comfortable working from existing concepts to shape them into a finished product.

If you’d like, I’d be happy to discuss your ideas, priorities, and timeline so we can plan the best way to bring the site to life.
